label: Fundamentals, Architecture & Connectivity
desc: 18 interview questions covering Fundamentals, Architecture, Connectivity, Installation and more.

subs.label: Fundamentals
subs.desc: Apache Superset is an open-source business intelligence (BI) and data visualization tool that lets users explore and analyze large datasets through interactive visualizations, dashboards, and SQL-based queries.

subs.label: Architecture
subs.desc: The web server, the database backend for the data being visualized, the metadata database that stores Superset's own dashboards/charts/connections, and the visualization engine that renders charts.

subs.label: Connectivity
subs.desc: What databases does Superset support? Can you explain the process of connecting a database to Superset?

subs.label: Installation
subs.desc: The simplest path is pip install apache-superset, though production deployments typically use Docker or Docker Compose for a more reproducible setup.

subs.label: Ecosystem
subs.desc: Can you integrate Superset with other BI tools or data platforms? Can you integrate Superset with version control systems?

label: SQL Lab & Query Engine
desc: 11 interview questions covering SQL Lab, Streaming.

subs.label: SQL Lab
subs.desc: SQL Lab is Superset's built-in feature for writing and executing SQL queries directly against connected databases — a full-featured SQL IDE inside the BI tool.

subs.label: Streaming
subs.desc: Superset's support here is limited — while it can connect to streaming platforms like Apache Kafka, its exploration capabilities are typically focused on visualizing historical snapshots rather than true real-time analysis.

label: Visualization, Dashboards & Reporting
desc: 19 interview questions covering Visualization, Dashboards, Data Modeling, Reporting.

subs.label: Visualization
subs.desc: Yes — Superset lets you build custom visualizations using the rich set of visualization libraries available in the Python/JavaScript ecosystem, beyond the built-in chart types.

subs.label: Dashboards
subs.desc: Yes — Superset provides embed codes or URLs that can be integrated into web pages or portals, letting dashboards live inside another application's UI.

subs.label: Data Modeling
subs.desc: Yes — Superset lets you define metrics (aggregations) and dimensions (groupings) at the dataset level to build complex analytical queries and visualizations without rewriting SQL each time.

subs.label: Reporting
subs.desc: Can you schedule and automate reports in Superset?

label: Performance, Caching & Scale
desc: 9 interview questions covering Performance, Caching, Deployment, Alerting.

subs.label: Performance
subs.desc: Using monitoring agents, log analyzers, and performance tracking tools — analyzing server logs, watching resource usage, and tracking query performance to identify and resolve bottlenecks.

subs.label: Caching
subs.desc: Superset caches query results to improve performance and reduce load on the underlying databases — subsequent identical requests are served from the cache instead of re-executing the query.

subs.label: Deployment
subs.desc: Yes — Superset supports multi-tenancy by letting you configure and manage multiple instances or workspaces within a single deployment, each with its own users, databases, and resources.

label: Security, Governance & Lineage
desc: 15 interview questions covering Security, Governance, Ecosystem.

subs.label: Security
subs.desc: Superset provides access control through role-based permissions — you define roles and assign them specific permissions governing who can access and modify datasets, slices, dashboards, and other resources.

subs.label: Governance
subs.desc: Yes — by capturing and displaying metadata information, Superset lets users trace the origin and transformations of data used across multiple dashboards and slices, not just within a single one.

subs.label: Ecosystem
subs.desc: What is Superset's integration with Apache Airflow? How can you extend Superset's functionality?
